page.content:
The Kahn Champion is a minor sub-boss encountered in Shao Kahn's Fortress within the Konquest mode of Mortal Kombat: Armageddon. Kahn Champions are a part of the Kahn Guard.

page.overview:
Who is Kahn Champion?

The Kahn Champion is a minor sub-boss encountered in Shao Kahn's Fortress within the Konquest mode of Mortal Kombat: Armageddon. Kahn Champions are a part of the Kahn Guard.

There is an enemy called Skull, who is equal to a Kahn Champion. Both are killed by the demi-god Taven during his quest.
